'''Fort Alde''' was a military installation of [[House Alde]] located in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Its defenses were led by [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Joral Alde]].
